nice_title: Cardiovascular disease risk assessment / BMI and waist circumference / Type 2 diabetes prevention
notes: No single NICE guideline for metabolic syndrome — managed by treating individual components

diagnostic_criteria_idf.required: Central obesity (waist >94cm M, >80cm F for Europeans)
plus_two_of: HDL <1.03 mmol/L M (<40 mg/dL) or <1.29 mmol/L F (<50 mg/dL)
Fasting glucose ≥5.6 mmol/L (100 mg/dL) or T2DM diagnosed

dyslipidaemia.notes: Consider fibrate (Fenofibrate) if triglycerides >4.5 despite statin

hyperglycaemia.notes: If prediabetes: intensive lifestyle intervention first (NICE PH38)
hyperglycaemia.guideline: Follow NICE NG28 if diabetes diagnosed

obesity.notes: Consider GLP-1 RA (Semaglutide/Liraglutide) for weight management
obesity.other: Consider bariatric surgery referral if BMI ≥40 or ≥35 with comorbidities

first_line_treatment.drug_class: Metformin (if diabetic or prediabetic with high risk)

contraindicated_drugs.reason: May worsen glucose tolerance and mask hypoglycaemia

monitoring: BMI and waist circumference: every visit
Fasting glucose / HbA1c: annually (6-monthly if prediabetic)
Lipid profile: annually (3 months after statin initiation)
Liver function: if on statin or if NAFLD suspected
non_pharmacological: Weight loss: 5-10% of body weight (most impactful intervention)
Exercise: 150 min/week moderate intensity + resistance training
Diet: Mediterranean diet, reduce refined carbohydrates and sugar
Sleep: assess for obstructive sleep apnoea (common in MetSyn)
Diabetes prevention programme referral if prediabetic (NICE PH38)
